summary: 30+ classic solitaire & card games with the Spanish deck. Play offline, no wifi
description:
Solitaire, also known as Patience, is a collection of 30+ classic solitaire and card games. Play with the traditional spanish card deck, and also classic and french decks. Enjoy them offline (100% no internet, no wifi) and turn on the winning deal option, which deals the cards so every game can be solved.

Relax, exercise your brain and play a quick hand of classic solitaire whenever you like. Very few ads, and never while you play.

30+ SOLITAIRE GAMES:
- American solitaire (Klondike)
- The pyramid
- Spider solitaire (one, two or four suits)
- FreeCell
- Tri Peaks
- Golf
- The four kings
- The Ten Piles
- Canfield
- Giza
- The clock
- Face cards dance
- Memory.
- Cards of Hanoi
- Let's add eight
- Puzzle
- Return Home
- The Egg
- Make Pairs
- Grandma
- One, Two, Three
.. and many more

Each solitaire includes its rules and instructions from the "Game" menu, so it's easy to learn.

SPANISH DECK & MORE
Play with the authentic Spanish card deck in HD, or switch to the traditional or French deck whenever you want.

FEATURES
- Offline play: enjoy your card games anywhere, no internet or wifi needed
- Winning deal: if you prefer, play games that always have a solution
- Classic solitaire for everyone, with readable text and a simple interface
- Auto-complete and unlimited undo moves
- Automatic save and full stats
- Works on phone and tablet (portrait and landscape)
- Customize deck, table background, card backs, font size and language

If you love classic card games, patience and the Spanish deck, this solitaire collection is for you. Download and enjoy classic solitaires, with or without internet.

The Spanish deck card images are property of Quarzo Apps. Any suggestion or bug report is welcome, before writing a bad review, email us at hola@quarzoapps.com. Thanks!
